title: Learning-quality judgment of an explainer, version 1
description: What the eval juror (evals/juror/prompt.md of @lernapps/tooling) found on a built explainer: a level per unit of each learning-quality item of review/archetypes/explainer.md, with its evidence. Checked and scored with `node evals/juror.ts <file>`.

grade.description: The grade or grade band the juror took the learner's role for

pages.description: Every page judged, as a path below url

unit.description: What on the page: the page itself, a figure, a component, an exercise

level.description: 0 stuck or misled, 1 with a detour or guess, 2 clear

evidence.description: What was read, quoted, and seen

did.description: What the juror did in the browser
